| | **DEFAULT JUDGMENT** | |

The plaintiff(s) having filed and served a notice of civil claim and the defendant(s) Corbin Vasey having failed to file and serve a response to civil claim within the time allowed;

THIS COURT ORDERS that the defendant(s) Corbin Vasey pay to the plaintiff(s) damages to be assessed. 🧐 <!-- order_sought_id 1 -->

THIS COURT FURTHER ORDERS that the defendant(s) Corbin Vasey pay to the plaintiff(s) costs to be assessed. 🧐 <!-- order_sought_id 2 -->

THIS COURT FURTHER ORDERS that, in the alternative, the defendant(s) Corbin Vasey pay to the plaintiff(s) costs in the fixed amount of $2,500. 🧐 <!-- order_sought_id 3 -->
